Summary: Group Expense Ledger, Splitting & Debt Settlement
Description: Track shared trip costs, compute zero-sum splits, and calculate the optimal Who Owes Whom settlement graph.

As a traveler, I want to create an account with my email and a strong password, so that my travel plans are securely isolated. Given valid email and 8+ char password, When registered, Then password hashed with bcrypt (salt 10).
As a registered traveler, I want to log in to receive a signed JWT token, so that I can securely authenticate API calls. Given valid credentials, When logged in, Then signed 24h JWT returned.
As a trip organizer, I want to create a new trip plan, so that I am designated as the trip Owner. Given authenticated user, When creating trip, Then creator assigned owner role.
As a platform security architect, I want role middleware, so that unauthorized actions return 403 Forbidden. Given viewer role, When mutating data, Then 403 Forbidden returned and audit logged.
As a trip planner, I want to add multiple destination stops with dates, so that the group route is clearly organized.
As a trip owner, I want to invite members with editor or viewer roles, so that companions collaborate under least privilege.
As an editor or owner, I want to schedule activities with times and locations, so that the group has a clear daily schedule.
As an itinerary coordinator, I want to assign specific activities to collaborators, so that responsibilities are delegated.

Summary: Group Expense Logging with Payer Designation
Description: As a group traveler, I want to log shared expenses with category and payer, so that group expenditures are tracked.
As a companion, I want expenses split equally or custom among members, so that costs are apportioned with exact cent precision.
As a group member, I want to view an optimal Who Owes Whom settlement summary, so that debts are resolved with minimum transfers.
As a security auditor, I want tamper-evident logs of logins and role modifications, so that platform actions are traceable.
Implement cryptographic password hashing with bcryptjs (salt 10).
Expose POST /api/auth/register with email validation and duplicate check.
Configure HMAC-SHA256 signature verification with secret key.
Implement POST /api/auth/login with password compare and audit logging.
